name: battle_bat_art
description: Bat trio battle renders the bat combat art (3x1 wings-spread frame0 at the art base, second row holding the blank/white padding cells of the folded frame) under the HP line -- pins the bat wiring end to end.  Parked on the bat's first patrol leg so the circle walk bumps the hero.  The art cells pin the folded-wings frame (frame index 1 at capture timing; the spread-wings frame renders at even (timer>>4) parity).
